connection_types.spec: printed piston in printed sleeve, 0.2 mm/side; two snap hooks in 35 mm windows retain it and let it travel the 32 mm crush stroke; flange stops on the sleeve end
crush cartridge slides in the sleeve and bears on the back wall in compression (0.5 mm preload, not bonded)
rubber sheet pressure-sensitive adhesive backing on a degreased printed face

edges.notes: shoe bonded over the half-fin TE tip: sleeve floor on the tip edge (x 0.283-0.320, 9.6 mm) + legs 10 mm down both faces; 1 100 mm2; 30 min epoxy, faces scuffed; printed/bonded design 86.8 N (C1 J-FOOT), CL-D5-BOND-SF 2.7. Permanent; a broken shoe is cut off with a razor saw and a spare bonded (cure 30 min)

field joint, no tools: press both hooks through the windows (fingernail or 2 mm hex key), pull the piston + cartridge out, push a pre-glued spare in until both click; <= 3 min (CL-D5-REPLACE-TIME). Crush stroke 32 mm toward -x
foam-safe CA, two drops on the piston floor; segments tacked to each other
pad cut 14.8 x 29 mm with the flange; wipe the flange with IPA first
landing load path: pad -> piston floor -> cartridge -> shoe back wall -> fin tip
